column1: # The differential stages run by scripts/ci/stages.py, in this order.
# stage <TAB> summary label <TAB> cases <TAB> skipped <TAB> byte-identical
# `cases` is passed + failed + skipped of the stage's `<label>: N passed,
# M failed` line: update it when the suite changes (UPSTREAM_REV, new twins,
# ...). `skipped` is the exact number of cases the stage skips, optionally
# followed by `<system>=<number>` for other platforms (`shape-hb` skips the
# cases that use macOS system fonts where those are missing; `wasm-spec`
# skips text modules). `byte-identical` is the least number the stage may
# report as "byte-identical before canonicalization" (raw hash parity), or
# `-`. Cases that are allowed to fail are listed in
